thread:
anya: UX quick sync  customers keep confusing the tiny 'KMS' badge in audit logs. They think it means "uses KMS" but can't tell which provider. Screenshot in thread. cc @dina

sam: Proposed fix: replace tiny badge with explicit 'Key management' column. Values: 'Redwood-managed' or 'Customer-managed key (KMS)'.

dina: Also retention tooltip currently says '30 days by default' which conflicts with org overrides. Change to 'Default retention (may be overridden by org settings)'.

marcus: Region dropdown ordering: users want org-default, then recents, then alphabetical. That helps EU customers see correct region first.

oliver: Accessibility: the badge has low contrast and no aria-label. Add 'aria-label="Key management: Customer-managed key (KMS)"' and visible focus. Also fix keyboard flow so badge is after actions.

anya: Agreed. Dina, can you make copy changes and include a11y notes in PR?

dina: Yep. Drafting PR: will change copy, add aria-labels, adjust contrast to >=4.5:1, and include screenshot tests for dark/light. ETA 48hrs.

sam: I'll create a backend ticket to return key_alias instead of nulls so UI avoids showing 'KMS' when metadata missing. PRODUCT-8342.

marcus: Also add a log filter 'Key management: Any/Redwood/Customer (KMS)'. Low lift and helpful.

anya: Outcome: column swap, tooltip copy update, a11y fixes, region ordering tweak, backend ticket. Closing if no objections.
